Question: A 38-year-old man consulted for dyspnea and hemoptysis. Blood tests have creatinine 7 mg / dl, urea 250 mg / dl and anti-MBG (anti-glomerular basement membrane antibodies) positive high titer. A renal biopsy was performed, showing crescents in 75% of the glomeruli, and in the immunofluorescence a linear Ig deposition pattern appeared. Which of the following is the correct answer?

Options:
opa. It is an Ig A Nephropathy with acute renal failure.
opb. The performance of plasmapheresis would be indicated.
opc. It is a membranous glomerulonephritis.
opd. Mycophenolate mofetil is the initial treatment of choice.
ope. Glomerular involvement is caused by the presence of circulating immune complexes.
